A streetwise man flees South Central Los Angeles, heading to the suburbs and his lottery-winner uncle and cousin to avoid a neighborhood thug with a grudge who has escaped from prison. But trouble soon follows, and the suburbs will never be the same.

Craig and Day-Day have finally moved into their own apartment, but a ghetto grinch breaks in and steals all their Christmas presents—and the rent money. To avoid eviction before Christmas, the cousins take jobs as unarmed security guards at a strip mall.
A single mom tries to work her way through college, moonlighting as an exotic dancer.
The spoof that started it all. Scream with the Wayans brothers, Carmen Electra, Shannon Elizabeth, and Anna Faris as they bumble and shriek their way to horror-movie hilarity in Scary Movie.
Four teens are tricked by their professor into visiting a haunted house for a school project.
David Zucker (AIRPLANE!) directs SCARY MOVIE 3, which piles on hysterical, yet gratuitous, cameos with thrillers, blockbusters, and pop-culture in general getting their best goosing yet.

The all-star cast returns to pull serious spoofs of The Grudge, Saw, War of the Worlds, and The Village. While her house is haunted by a little boy, Cindy is determined to find out who killed him and why.
